bottom_line: Opposition gains in Turkey local elections signal potential policy shift risk for investors with Turkish exposure.
what_changed: Opposition party won mayoralties in major cities including Istanbul and Ankara, reversing years of ruling party dominance in urban centers.
why_it_matters: Municipal control affects infrastructure procurement, local regulation, and signals broader political trajectory that investors and trade partners monitor.
main_uncertainty: Local election results do not directly translate to national policy changes; ruling party retains parliamentary majority.

scenarios.name: Policy continuity
scenarios.description: National policy unchanged; local elections treated as protest vote.

scenarios.name: Reform signal
scenarios.description: Ruling party adjusts economic policy to regain urban support.

watch_next: Municipal policy changes in opposition-held cities
